prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one production 2D enemy animation atlas for Yokai Delivery. Keep the EXACT character identity, proportions, costume, palette, crisp ink outlines and painted Japanese storybook shading from the reference. Reference is design guidance; its magenta background is NOT part of the character. Create one horizontal transparent PNG strip with exactly TWO equal rectangular cells, intended aspect 2:1, each occupying exactly half the image width and the entire height. Left cell: an alternate movement drawing of the same blue flame ghost, flame tip and cheeks flowing to the opposite side while the core face stays recognizable. Right cell: contact-attack lunge, eyebrows lowered, mouth open with the same fangs, blue flame body thrust forward. No detached projectile. Keep the original viewing angle and facing direction. Exactly one complete full-body enemy per cell, aligned to the same ground/contact point at 90% of cell height. Pose height and proportions match across cells, at least 8% clear margin on all cell edges, no cell crossing or clipping. Distinct actual limb/body poses, not mere translation, flip, brightness change or blur. No text, no labels, no frame borders, no checkerboard, NO magenta background. Truly transparent alpha everywhere outside character, no broad glow or floor shadow. Sharp silhouette at a 50-125 pixel in-game height. Keep attacks readable but do not change the enemy design.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one two-state illustrated landmark atlas for the existing Japanese courier game overworld, NOT a whole new world map. Two equal square cells in a horizontal 2:1 transparent PNG strip. Each cell is exactly half the image width. Night Town: compact cluster of Edo wooden machiya merchant houses, tiled eaves, small delivery doorway and red hanging lanterns, cozy human-scale silhouette. Use reference for the same wood/roof ink and paint style. Left cell: night before clearing, shutters closed, lanterns dim, subdued blue-grey wood. Right cell: the exact SAME cluster, shutters opened, warm honey lantern and window light, a small blank vermilion cloth delivery pennant; geometry and footprint unchanged. Three-quarter top-down illustrated map landmark, ink outlines and softly painted wood/paper surfaces, detail subordinate to bold identifiable silhouette at 100 pixels wide. Center each landmark in its own cell with identical scale and identical ground point at 88% cell height. Allow 10% transparent margin on every edge, no overlapping cells. No characters, no text, no lettering, no labels, no boxes, no background landscape, no enormous sparkle or fog halo. Truly transparent alpha, no pink, no checkerboard. Clear structural daylight readability despite nocturnal palette. Right state differs by physical open shutters/flags and lit lamps, not a mere recolor. Preserve space around the silhouette so node labels remain legible below it.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE standalone production game sprite, not a sprite sheet. Preserve exact identity of the reference courier: young fox-eared girl, dark blue wave-pattern happi coat, red rope headband, fox mask decoration, wooden delivery backpack, brown boots and cream paper lantern on bamboo stick. Same hand-painted Japanese storybook ink style and palette; three-quarter side view facing RIGHT. Dash burst: courier leans forward low in a powerful sprint, rear leg pushing off, front knee lifted, coat and backpack trailing; lantern held low and forward securely. SINGLE standalone whole character. Exactly ONE figure in the entire image. Entire figure, ears, bamboo stick, lantern and backpack visible with at least 8% empty margin. No text, no labels, no borders, no duplicate characters, no grid. True transparent alpha background, no fog, vignette, backdrop or cast shadow. Character should be centered and a clear action silhouette. Do not include the original idle pose. Intended portrait canvas for victory, square canvas for dash/kneel.
